The deciding trade-offs

Pay $300 for Aero?

Compared with Nimbus, you get OLED and double the storage. You carry 0.2 kg more and give up 4 hours of listed battery life.

Step up to Forge?

For $600 more than Aero, you get double the RAM and storage, upgradeability and more ports—but 0.9 kg more weight and half the listed battery life.

Keep it simple with Nimbus?

The lowest price, lightest weight and longest battery make a compelling everyday package. Be comfortable with 256 GB of storage and a dimmer display.
